Hi Alyssa — thanks for the note and for outlining the window. Short answers up front: yes, we can provide the SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter where appropriate; we support S3 pre-signed links, SFTP drops, and secure SharePoint/Google Drive shares. Below is a compact intake and a suggested reply template you can paste into your vendor portal.

---- Intake checklist (minimal to accelerate delivery) ----
- Confirm the audited period you need (you listed Oct 1, 2026 — Sep 30, 2027).
- Confirm whether you need raw telemetry/log samples (we typically provide short, redacted extracts on request).
- Indicate preferred transfer method (S3 pre-signed / SFTP / secure SharePoint).
- Tell us if you need control mappings to SIG/CAIQ fields — we can include a mapping spreadsheet.

We will redact customer identifiers by default; if you need fully unredacted artifacts we can discuss an NDA addendum.

---- Suggested portal reply (copy/paste) ----
"Redwood Inference will provide their SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter if required. Delivery options: S3 pre-signed link, SFTP drop, or secure SharePoint. Requested artifacts include the SOC 2 report PDF, control mapping spreadsheet, and limited redacted log samples on request. Please provide the exact audit window you require and the preferred transfer method"

---- Attachments I'm including (stubs) ----
- redwood_bridge_letter_template.pdf — our standard bridge letter format (editable).
- control_mapping_example.xlsx — sample control-to-SIG mapping to show format.
- evidence_transfer_options.txt — short note on transfer methods and timelines.

Jonas, tagging you for awareness on any special approvals for unredacted logs.

Next steps for Alyssa: confirm the exact audit window and preferred transfer mechanism and we will generate a delivery plan (ETA: 2 business days after confirmation for standard report delivery).

Best,
Mina Haddad
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Alyssa — no problem, thanks for clarifying the window. That window (Aug 1, 2026 — Jul 31, 2027) will usually be handled one of two ways:

1) If our most recent SOC 2 Type II report covers a period that fully contains your window, we provide the report PDF and a one-paragraph cover note confirming the audit dates.
2) If our report's audit period ends before your requested end date, we'll provide the report plus a bridge letter that: (a) confirms the covered audit period, (b) summarizes any changes in scope since the report, and (c) indicates controls that continued unchanged.

We do not provide retroactive re-testing; bridge letters are informational for auditor review. If your auditors require a control-to-window mapping, we can produce a short attestation spreadsheet that maps key control families to the requested window (redacted where necessary).

Preferred transfer: S3 pre-signed links — noted. We'll prepare a package with: SOC 2 report PDF, bridge-letter draft (if needed), control mapping spreadsheet, and a short readme describing redaction policy. ETA: I can generate the pre-signed link within 2 business days after you confirm final acceptance of our standard redaction approach (we'll default to vendor-redacted).

If acceptable, reply with "Confirm: vendor-redacted is OK; send via S3 pre-signed link" and we'll proceed.

Best regards,
Mina
Security Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
